blocks.orig: The Hakuna Matata Academy believes that knowledge is power. Launched in 2022, the HMA is an on-the-ground initiative created by the founders of Your Tanzania Trip. Located next to their office in Arusha, HMA offers specialised hospitality training programs to both vulnerable street kids and professionals working in the hospitality and tourism sector. The Hakuna Matata Academy is the first of its kind in Tanzania.
blocks.html: At the Hakuna Matata Academy, the conviction is that knowledge is power. Set up in 2022 by the founders of Your Tanzania Trip, the HMA is a hands-on initiative based right next to their office in Arusha. It runs specialised hospitality training programmes for two groups: vulnerable street kids and professionals already working in hospitality and tourism. Nothing like the Hakuna Matata Academy existed in Tanzania before.

blocks.orig: “We started the Hakuna Matata Academy (HMA), because of the wish to make a positive impact in Tanzania. HMA offers opportunities to vulnerable street kids as well as people working in tourism. Eventually, Your Tanzania Trip wants to improve the level of service and the sustainability of the tourism sector. Because making impact in a sustainable way helps both the people and the environment!”
blocks.html: “The Hakuna Matata Academy (HMA) grew out of our wish to make a positive difference in Tanzania. HMA creates opportunities for vulnerable street kids and for people employed in tourism alike. In the long run, Your Tanzania Trip wants to raise both the standard of service and the sustainability of the tourism sector. Making an impact in a sustainable way benefits people and the environment at the same time!”

blocks.orig: The Hakuna Matata Academy currently has six trainers. The academy offers professionals from each of the 80 lodges partnered with Your Tanzania Trip a spot in its professional training and mentoring programs. After receiving a one-month theoretical and practical training from local and international sector experts, the HMA graduates are equipped with a varied and professional skill set that improves service in the lodges and provides the graduate with exciting opportunities for professional growth. In addition, 200 young adults coming from vulnerable groups are currently professionally trained to follow internships at the 80 participating lodges. Their training takes one year and this year 100 participants managed to start their internships.
blocks.html: Six trainers currently work at the Hakuna Matata Academy. Each of the 80 lodges that partner with Your Tanzania Trip can send a professional to the academy's training and mentoring programmes. After a month of theoretical and practical instruction by local and international experts from the sector, HMA graduates leave with a broad, professional skill set that raises the standard of service in the lodges and opens up real opportunities for their own careers. Alongside this, 200 young adults from vulnerable groups are currently being trained to take up internships at the 80 participating lodges. That training lasts a year, and this year 100 participants have already been able to start their internships.

blocks.orig: The Hakuna Matata Academy is financed with support from the DeveloPPP program of DEG Impulse, a German investment organization for developing countries that is financed by the German Federal for Economic Cooperation and Development.
blocks.html: Funding for the Hakuna Matata Academy comes with support from the DeveloPPP programme of DEG Impulse, a German investment organisation for developing countries, which in turn is funded by the German Federal for Economic Cooperation and Development.
